description: CCP-15 independently derived conformance vectors for CCA state transitions, interference scoring, frequency agility, adaptive SF selection, and TDMA slot assignment.

vectors.name: cca_clear_resets_contention
vectors.description: A clear CAD permits TX and resets retry/backoff state.

vectors.name: cca_busy_advances_contention
vectors.description: A busy CAD blocks TX, increments retries, and raises the backoff exponent.

vectors.name: cca_retry_limit_exhausted
vectors.description: The fourth busy CAD exceeds the three-retry limit and fails closed.

vectors.name: interference_idle
vectors.description: Interference score in tenths of a percentage point: busy_percent*10 + packet_error_permille.

vectors.name: interference_moderate
vectors.description: Interference score in tenths of a percentage point: busy_percent*10 + packet_error_permille.

vectors.name: interference_saturated
vectors.description: Interference score in tenths of a percentage point: busy_percent*10 + packet_error_permille.

vectors.name: frequency_agility_normal
vectors.description: SelectChannel hashes EUI-64 || epoch-u32-le, uses at least three channels, and falls back to CH0 above density eight.

vectors.name: frequency_agility_high_density_ch0
vectors.description: SelectChannel hashes EUI-64 || epoch-u32-le, uses at least three channels, and falls back to CH0 above density eight.

vectors.name: frequency_agility_minimum_modulus
vectors.description: SelectChannel hashes EUI-64 || epoch-u32-le, uses at least three channels, and falls back to CH0 above density eight.

vectors.name: sf_high_density
vectors.description: AdaptiveSFSelect boundary case derived from the normative CCP-15 pseudocode and threshold table.

vectors.name: sf_low_density_good_snr
vectors.description: AdaptiveSFSelect boundary case derived from the normative CCP-15 pseudocode and threshold table.

vectors.name: sf_loss_above_threshold
vectors.description: AdaptiveSFSelect boundary case derived from the normative CCP-15 pseudocode and threshold table.

vectors.name: sf_utilization_blocks_tx
vectors.description: AdaptiveSFSelect boundary case derived from the normative CCP-15 pseudocode and threshold table.

vectors.name: tdma_slot_baseline
vectors.description: TDMA slot is (FNV1a32(EUI-64) + u32(SFN)) mod 2^32, then mod num_slots.

vectors.name: tdma_slot_wrapping_sum
vectors.description: TDMA slot is (FNV1a32(EUI-64) + u32(SFN)) mod 2^32, then mod num_slots.

vectors.name: tdma_slot_zero_eui
vectors.description: TDMA slot is (FNV1a32(EUI-64) + u32(SFN)) mod 2^32, then mod num_slots.
